objective: Preallocate Fusion storage obsolete SSTable buffers for the first compaction output.

tasks.title: Preallocate obsolete SSTable buffer
tasks.result: Fusion storage now creates the obsolete SSTable queue with capacity for the first compaction candidate retained for deferred deletion.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The obsolete SSTable buffer capacity is 1 because the first successful compaction pushes its first old SSTable into this queue.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for obsolete SSTable handles; compaction replacement, Arc strong-count checks, deferred deletion, and file removal semantics are unchanged.
